title: Ninja Black Friday deals 2026: what's cheap now and what to wait for
description: The best Ninja deals in the run-up to Black Friday 2026, plus last year's Black Friday prices so you know a real bargain when you see one.
intro:
**Short answer: the Ninja Slushi at £199.99 is already £24 cheaper than its lowest price last Black Friday, so buy it now if it's on your list.** The Perfect Temperature kettle (£59.99) and the CRISPi air fryer (£120) are also close to Black Friday prices. For bigger Ninja kit, like the Creami Scoop & Swirl, Double Stack and Foodi MAX, last year's Black Friday prices were noticeably lower than today's, so it's worth waiting until 27 November.

We update this page as prices move. These prices were last checked on 26 October 2026.

body:
## Ninja prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the prices Ninja products hit during last year's Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales (late November to early December 2025). If you see something at or below this figure, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **Ninja Slushi frozen drinks maker:** £224 (already beaten: £199.99 at Ninja on 26 October)
- **Ninja Creami Scoop & Swirl:** £273 (usually £349.99)
- **Ninja Crispi portable air fryer:** £117 (usually £149.99)
- **Ninja Foodi MAX Dual Zone (AF400UK):** £143 (usually £229)
- **Ninja Foodi 4-in-1 air fryer (AF200UK):** £99.99 (usually £119.99)
- **Ninja Double Stack XL air fryer:** £188 (usually £269.99)
- **Ninja Combi 12-in-1 multi-cooker:** £179.99 (usually £279.99)
- **Ninja Foodi 11-in-1 SmartLid multi-cooker:** £179.99 (usually £279.99)
- **Ninja Blast portable blender:** £39.99 (usually £49.99)

## Which Ninja is worth buying?

**Air fryers:** for most households, a dual-drawer model is the one to get, because you can cook a main and a side at the same time. The Foodi MAX Dual Zone is the best value at its Black Friday price. The Double Stack XL fits the same capacity into a narrower footprint, which matters in a small kitchen. The Crispi suits one or two people, or anyone who wants to cook and store food in the same glass dish.

**Creami vs Slushi:** the Creami makes proper scoopable ice cream from a base you freeze the day before. The Slushi makes slushies and frozen drinks on demand. If it's a family gift, the Slushi gets more use in summer and the Creami gets more use all year.

**Kettles and blenders:** these get smaller discounts, but the Perfect Temperature kettle is already at a good price now. The Luxe Café Mini Plus coffee machine is full price everywhere we checked, so wait for that.

## When do Ninja prices drop?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**, and Cyber Monday on **30 November**. Ninja products usually start getting cut in the week before, and the lowest prices often appear on Amazon, Argos and Currys at the same time, because they match each other. Ninja's own website runs its own sale too, but often isn't the cheapest.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday for a Ninja air fryer?

For bigger models, usually yes: last year the Foodi MAX Dual Zone and Double Stack XL were £80 or more cheaper than their usual prices. Smaller models like the Crispi only drop by a few pounds more.

### Are Black Friday Ninja deals real discounts?

Mostly. Ninja's "was" prices are its standard prices, and the brand rarely inflates them before a sale. Even so, check the price against the target list above before you buy.

### Where is cheapest for Ninja on Black Friday?

Amazon, Argos and Currys usually match each other within hours. Very and Ninja's own site sometimes go lower on specific models, which we'll flag here as the sale goes on.
